Zone shot chart with annotated makes and attempts

Source: R/shots.R
plot_shot_zones.Rd

The court painted by zone. Fill is FG% versus the league in that zone (shrunk), and each zone is labelled with makes/attempts, FG% and its share of the player's shots: real court zones and a diverging scale.

Usage

plot_shot_zones(
  shots,
  baseline = shots,
  league = NULL,
  detail = TRUE,
  limit = 0.1,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL
)

Arguments

shots

Shot data (see Details in plot_shot_hex()).

baseline

Shots used for the league reference; defaults to shots. Pass the whole league so a single player is compared with everyone.

league

Court to draw; defaults to the league in the data.

detail

Use 12 side-split zones (default) or 5 distance zones.

limit

Colour scale limit (+-).

title, subtitle, caption

Labels. A default subtitle explains the encoding.

Examples

plot_shot_zones(subset(shots_2024, player == "Nikola Jokic"),
                baseline = subset(shots_2024, league == "NBA"),
                title = "Nikola Jokic")
